body:
WHAT
The OpenAI-compatible provider sends optional body fields (stream_options, max_tokens, num_ctx, chat_template_kwargs, reasoning_effort). If the server answers 400/422 with a body naming one of them, the provider drops that field (or renames max_tokens to max_completion_tokens), re-sends once, and remembers the rejection for the life of the provider instance. reasoning_effort levels are clamped toward the nearest accepted level. The `tools` field is never dropped.

WHY
Servers differ in which optional fields they accept; without negotiation an unfamiliar API killed the whole turn, and dropping tools would silently make the agent tool-less.

WHERE
engine/providers/src/openai-compat.ts — type NegotiableField, rejectedField(errorText) (guards looksLikeContextOverflow), class OpenAICompatProvider: private rejected Set, effort EffortClamp, buildBody(req) (maxTokensKey rename, conditional stream_options / num_ctx / chat_template_kwargs / reasoning_effort, unconditional tools), stream() retry loop (`for (;;)` re-sending after this.rejected.add(field) or this.effort.reject()). engine/providers/src/effort.ts — WIRE_EFFORTS, toWireEffort(), class EffortClamp (resolve/reject/describe), mentionsReasoningEffort(), looksLikeUnknownField().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a fake fetch that returns 400 '{"error":"Unrecognized request argument: stream_options"}' on the first call and 200 SSE on the second, stream() makes exactly two requests and the second body has no stream_options; a third stream() call on the same instance sends one request without stream_options.
2. A 400 naming max_completion_tokens (or 'max_tokens is not supported') makes the re-sent body carry max_completion_tokens with the same value and no max_tokens key.
3. A 400 whose text says 'max_tokens + prompt exceed the context length' is NOT treated as a field rejection: stream() throws ProviderHttpError after one request.
4. Every request body, including re-sends after a rejection, still contains the `tools` array when req.tools is non-empty; a 400 mentioning 'tools' throws instead of dropping them.
5. With reasoning_effort 'max' rejected by a value complaint, the retry sends 'xhigh', then 'high'; a body saying the field is unrecognized drops reasoning_effort entirely and onNegotiated receives the 'does not accept a reasoning-effort setting' note once, on the accepted request.
